descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S18 「从养老院：Settings 显示账号、隐私、删除、支持和版本这几行；Sign out 回到登录界面，两个列表都还有拦截」 From Nursing Home: Settings shows the account, privacy, delete, support and version rows; Sign out lands on the sign-in screen and the lists stay gated

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T5 Sign out ends the session. The physician must sign in again with an email code.（TFA-94700 AC 2）
  • T11 Settings shows the signed-in physician's email, Sign out, Privacy Policy, Delete account, a Support contact and the app version, the same way in Hospital and in Nursing Home. …（TFA-94700 AC 1；TFA-94700 AC 3；TFA-94700 AC 7）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given The lane C fixture (signed in, consented)

When The agent switches to Nursing Home, opens Settings, presses Sign out, then opens /snf and /rounding

Then Settings, opened from the Nursing Home list, shows who is signed in, Sign out, Sign out everywhere, Delete account, Privacy Policy, Contact support and the version. After Sign out, the sign-in screen shows the Email field and Send sign-in code, and neither test patient. Both lists still show the sign-in screen and neither test patient.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：oracle.mjs mustContain / mustNotContain per checkpoint: T11 (TFA-94700 AC 1 and 7: the Settings rows in Nursing Home) on cp1, T5 (AC 2: the session is ended and a sign-in is needed again) on cp2-cp4. Both are ungated TFA-94700 requirements, so a failure reports as Fail. The sign-in screen's copy (T1) is S16 cp1; link targets are S20 and S23.

在哪跑：本地 lane C（浏览器 agent 用例）；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-01.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane C。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane C）。

UAT item: OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-01/S18

Plan said: local-only — this run has a result anyway, so the result is shown.

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The goal presses Sign out, which is always refused on dev because it ends the saved sign-in every dev run uses (runner-contract §10.4), and then checks the signed-out lists.. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
